method: Blind answer-key audit. Items were exported with runtime-style shuffled options (keys stored separately). Independent subagents answered using only a text pack of the course sources (decks, lecture transcripts, video captions, OPE transcript, handouts, textbook chapters, syllabus, historical codex) and were forbidden from reading the lab, the keys or the package. Answers were then compared to the keys programmatically.
